name: agent-timezone-lock
description: Stops an OpenClaw agent from reporting the wrong time. Prevents the UTC-as-local mistake. Detects user timezone from USER.md or system, provides now.py for accurate local time, and /timezone command. AGENTS.md is only patched with explicit user opt-in (--patch-agents flag). Does NOT auto-trigger on every message — only when time accuracy is explicitly at issue.
author: Caddy Crew (Pods + Rex + Sloane)
